meta.name: A4 base — simply supported beam 400x50, eigenpair-refresh study
meta.notes: AUTHORITATIVE BASE CONFIG for A4 (examples/Revision_v1/A4_SPECIFICATION_V3.md). This is the ONLY A4 configuration. The refresh interval N is the single independent variable and is injected by a4_eigenpair_refresh.m as domain.load_cases[0].loads[0].update_after; NOTHING else differs between arms (validator: scripts/revision_v1/validate_a4_configs.py). Mass interpolation is LINEAR (pmass=1) per MASS_INTERPOLATION_DECISION.md — stated explicitly, not left to the solver default, so the arms cannot drift. semi_harmonic_baseline=solid is the authoritative reference (Gate A0-F1) and is enforced by the solver. Do NOT use ss_beam.json (baseline='initial' + semi_harmonic_rho_source: would throw under Gate A0) and do NOT use ss_beam_harmonic_*.json (retired EXP4 variants: harmonic load + MMA + partial dF/dx at 160x20).
